request.spec:
A fourth role, restricted, can be assigned. A restricted user sees on the people list only the
people of the crews they lead or belong to (by a person with the user's name) and that person
themselves: no other row is on the screen. Every other figure (the totals row, the header, the
summary, the periods, the pools) is still over everyone on the sheet.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A fourth role, restricted, can be assigned. A restricted user sees on the people list only the
people of the crews they lead or belong to (by a person with the user's name) and that person
themselves: no other row is on the screen. Every other figure (the totals row, the header, the
summary, the periods, the pools) is still over everyone on the sheet.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit

AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
I added the new **restricted** role, and all 4 tests in `bin/e2e` pass.

**What a restricted user sees:** the people list shows only people whose name (or an alias of it) is the user's name, plus the lead and members of every crew such a person leads or belongs to. Every other figure is still worked out over everyone on the sheet, because only the list's rows are filtered. That covers the totals row, header, summary, periods and pools.

**Changes:**
- **Server:**
  - `RESTRICTED` is added to `Role.java`. Roles are stored as text, so no migration was needed.
  - Any other role value is still refused, and the error message now lists the new role.
- **Front end:**
  - `restricted` is now one of the allowed roles in `useSettings.ts`, and the role form's placeholder and error text name it.
  - The filter is a new `useVisiblePeople` hook in `features/people/people.slot.tsx`. It reuses the header's rule for matching the user's name: case and surrounding spaces are ignored, and aliases count.

**Choices I made that you may want to check:**
- **List starts empty while loading:** for every user, the list shows no rows until their role has been read, and for a restricted user until the crews have loaded too. This stops a restricted user from briefly seeing everyone. The cost is that the list may appear slightly later for other roles.
- **Clerk limit:** outside the list, a restricted user acts like a clerk. So in `ApplyClaimStatus.java`, the clerk settle limit now applies to them as well (a settle over the limit goes to PENDING). The request didn't say either way.
- **Permission rules:** if a sheet sets which roles may take an action, those rules can still only name clerk and steward. A restricted user isn't matched by them, so they can't take an action that has its own rule set.
